summary: Backend-only regression validation of the iteration-29 routes refactor (MESSAGES / BOOKINGS / ADMIN / PAYMENTS moved from server.py to backend/routes/*.py). 30/30 pytest cases pass against the live preview URL. Verified: messages GET/unread/POST (including empty-body 400 and unauth 401), bookings list+history+clear-all+me/stats+passes/qr, 404s for bogus booking IDs on cancel/reschedule/checkin-code, POST /api/payments/reconcile returns {paid_booking_ids:[]}, admin overview with all required counters (classes/members/session_requests/refunds_pending/bug_reports_open), admin classes list, admin class CRUD (create by-appointment -> PUT edit -> DELETE cleanup), admin guard 403 for member token on /admin/overview and /admin/classes, payments receipts list, 404 for bogus payment status + receipt, and that POST /api/payments/checkout is REGISTERED (401/422 for unauth/malformed, NOT 404 or 405). Core sanity (auth login admin+member, GET /api/classes, /api/gym/photos, /api/events) all still working. Created a pending booking for a fixed class and cleaned it up via /bookings/{id}/clear — did NOT touch any Square checkout. No regressions found; refactor is byte-identical in behaviour.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/bookings.py imports 18 symbols from server.py — functional but makes the circular-ish coupling obvious. If any helper is renamed/removed from server.py, the route module will NameError at startup. Consider moving the pure helpers (booking_ref_no, coach_photo, _enrich_bookings) into a backend/utils/ module next.

routes/payments.py: _reuse_open_square_checkout dict is built with credit_applied_cents BEFORE confirming the user has enough credit remaining — fine because deduction and dedup lookup both happen upstream, just noting the implicit contract.

routes/admin.py admin_class_create for by-appointment path sets capacity=1 and start_at=now_utc(). Fine for appointments, but admin UIs that read start_at may show 'starts now' briefly in listings — cosmetic only.

Both routers are registered under /api via api.include_router(...) at server.py:6494, so paths are unchanged. Shared helpers (mark_booking_paid, sync_square_payment, make_checkin_code, reconcile_user_payments, Square config, notify_* etc.) remain in server.py and are imported successfully by the four new route modules (verified: no NameError/ImportError at startup; all 30 tests pass).
